mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of a broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST decreases > 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which is a lagging indicator of economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with low growth
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 YoY growth < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months signals a strengthening supply side, which is a positive indicator for economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, which is a negative indicator for economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decreases > 0.1% MoM and UNRATE increases > 0.1% MoM
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS decreases > 0.1% MoM and UNRATE increases > 0.1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% for more than 6 months signals an accommodative monetary policy, which is a positive indicator for equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS < 1% for > 6 months.
